announcements.text: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Linthicum Heights, Maryland, has been awarded a $79,608,480 modification (P00191) to a previously awarded contract (FA8615-17-C-6047) for Active Electronically Scanned Array radars of Air Force F-16 aircraft. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $2,061,087,012 from $1,981,478,532. Work will be performed in Linthicum Heights, Maryland, and is expected to be completed Dec. 31, 2027. Fiscal 2027 procurement funds in the amount of $19,688,883; fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,843,160; fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $35,937,544; fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $11,372,640; and fiscal 2025 procurement funds in the amount of $9,766,253, are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Raytheon Co., El Segundo, California, is awarded a $42,121,481 fixed-price incentive (firm-target) and cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00010) to a previously awarded contract (N0001925C0104) to incorporate the mid-band extended configuration into low-rate initial production Lot Five of the Next Generation Jammer Mid-Band program. The modification converts the existing production requirement to the mid-band extended configuration without increasing the existing Lot Five quantity. The effort includes manufacture, integration, test, delivery, associated spares, non-recurring engineering, production and test support, integrated logistics support, and technical data deliverables. Work will be performed in McKinney, Texas (65.7%); Forest, Mississippi (20.4%); El Segundo, California (13.4%); and Andover, Massachusetts (0.5%), and is expected to be completed in May 2029. Fiscal 2027 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $5,249,957; fiscal 2025 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $28,819,791; and foreign cooperative projects (Navy) funds in the amount of $8,051,732, will be obligated at the time of award. This contract modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
